title: Traditional Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting dish from Ukraine, featuring tender pork dumplings served with a side of fried onions and fresh dill.
instructions: Combine ground pork, salt, and black pepper in a large mixing bowl.
Add 1 egg to the pork mixture and mix until just combined.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a round cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Dampen the edges of the dough with water and fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Fry the dumplings until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of fried onions and fresh dill.
